metadata.description: linehaul.ai plugin collection for Claude Code

plugins.name: slack-go-sdk
plugins.description: Comprehensive guidance for building Slack applications with the official Go SDK, covering Web API, Canvas/Calls/Assistant, Socket Mode, Events API, OAuth, and Enterprise Grid admin

plugins.name: slack-block-kit-builder
plugins.description: Build Slack Block Kit UIs for messages, modals, and Home tabs

plugins.name: mycarrierpackets-api
plugins.description: MyCarrierPackets API integration for TMS systems. 23 endpoints with per-endpoint reference files: Intellivite invitations, Assure Advantage monitoring, document retrieval, fraud detection, VIN verification, block/unblock, factoring, OAuth2, and webhook event handling (packet completion, incident reports, VIN/user verification).

plugins.name: roadmap
plugins.description: Project roadmap management with GitHub Projects integration

plugins.name: laneweaver-tms-agents
plugins.description: Development agents and freight domain skills for laneweaverTMS. Context-isolated agents for database schema and frontend work, plus freight industry knowledge, RBAC patterns, geospatial/PostGIS patterns, and API integration patterns.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Context preservation for long-running conversations. Create structured handoff documents and resume work across sessions.

plugins.name: gh-issue
plugins.description: Create structured GitHub issues from conversation context with hierarchical sub-tasks and proper formatting.

plugins.name: jutsu-go
plugins.description: Advanced Go skills for concurrency, error handling, and interfaces. Includes hooks for go fmt, go vet, and go test on Stop events.

plugins.name: go-tdd
plugins.description: TDD workflow for Go using stretchr/testify and testcontainers-go. Orchestrates parallel subagents to write unit tests, integration tests, and execute the red-green-refactor cycle.

plugins.name: testcontainers-go
plugins.description: Guide for using Testcontainers for Go with 62+ pre-configured modules for integration testing

plugins.name: mass-refactor
plugins.description: Loop-driven mass refactor: an implementer/2-adversarial-reviewer/fixer cycle, isolated in git worktrees, run to convergence against a build or test command.

plugins.name: deep-wiki
plugins.description: AI-powered wiki generator for code repositories. Generates Mermaid-rich documentation with dark-mode VitePress sites, onboarding guides, deep research, and source citations.
